在最近于泰国曼谷圆满落幕的2026年亚洲食品博览会上，YuKoLi携全新第五代智能烹饪机器人惊艳亮相，成为全场焦点。本次博览会吸引了来自东南亚、南亚和中东地区的2000多家餐饮企业。

第五代智能烹饪机器人相比前代产品实现了全面升级，搭载全新AI烹饪引擎，支持超过800种菜谱，涵盖中餐、东南亚菜和西餐。配备精准温控系统和自适应翻炒技术，该设备烹饪一致性达到99.5%，远超行业平均水平。

YuKoLi展位在整个博览会期间人流不断，来自泰国、越南、马来西亚和印度尼西亚的200多个餐饮品牌代表亲身体验了该设备。多家连锁餐饮集团当场表达了合作意向，首批50台设备预计在六个月内交付并部署。

YuKoLi首席执行官在接受媒体采访时表示：“我们的目标不仅是提供智能设备，更是为餐饮企业打造完整的智能厨房解决方案。通过AI技术与物联网平台的深度融合，YuKoLi帮助客户实现从备餐到装盘的全流程标准化和自动化，在确保每道菜品高品质和一致性的同时，大幅降低人力成本。”

此外，YuKoLi还在博览会上发布了全新的云管理平台，支持远程设备监控、自动维护提醒和一键菜谱更新，进一步提升商业厨房的运营效率和智能化水平。

该连锁品牌在泰国、越南和柬埔寨运营三大业务板块——快餐、休闲餐饮和高端餐饮。通过引入YuKoLi自动化烹饪线，该品牌在其中央厨房实现了从食材准备、自动烹饪到成品包装的全自动化生产，每家门店的日均餐食产量提升了3倍，同时人力成本降低了65%。

该项目分三个阶段推进：第一阶段在30家旗舰店进行设备安装和调试，第二阶段覆盖其余56家门店，第三阶段将推出YuKoLi云管理平台，实现整个网络的统一调度和数据分析。

该连锁品牌的运营总监表示：“YuKoLi的设备在试用期间表现非常出色。食品质量的高度一致性显著提升了客户满意度。更重要的是，YuKoLi团队提供了全面的售后服务和技朮支持，让我们在整个部署过程中充满信心。”

YuKoLi东南亚区域总监透露，该项目的成功实施为公司在该地区的扩张奠定了坚实基础。多个国家的多家餐饮公司目前正在洽谈类似的大规模自动化项目，预计2026年下半年将迎来另一波订单。

经过严格的六个月审核和现场检查流程，YuKoLi所有产品成功获得ISO 9001:2015国际质量管理体系认证和欧盟CE安全合规认证，标志着公司在质量控制和国际市场准入能力方面取得了重要里程碑。

ISO 9001:2015认证要求企业在质量管理各个方面达到国际标准，包括研发设计、制造、供应链管理和售后服务。审核机构对YuKoLi的质量管理体系给予了高度评价，特别认可了公司在原材料可追溯性、标准化生产过程控制和发货前产品检验方面的严谨态度。

CE认证是欧盟市场的强制性准入要求，涉及电气安全、机械安全和电磁兼容性等多个维度的严格测试。YuKoLi所有智能烹饪设备均成功通过各项测试类别，证明产品在安全性和可靠性方面已达到世界级标准。

YuKoLi质量管理总监表示：“获得双认证是我们长期坚持质量优先战略的重要成果。我们在质量管理体系建设上投入了大量资源，从供应商筛选到最终产品交付的每一步都遵循严格的标准和流程。这些认证不仅是对我们现有工作的认可，也是持续改进的动力。”

support_faq_cat_1_q1: TRANSLATE: How do I choose the right commercial kitchen equipment?
support_faq_cat_1_a1: TRANSLATE: Consider these factors: 1) Cuisine type — induction wok ranges for Chinese stir-fry, ovens and fryers for Western baking, food processors for fast-casual prep; 2) Daily output — estimate capacity based on daily covers; 3) Kitchen footprint — countertop models save space, floor-standing units offer higher throughput; 4) Power supply — confirm whether your site has 220 V or 380 V. Submit your requirements via our Get a Quote page and our engineers will recommend the optimal configuration.
support_faq_cat_1_q2: TRANSLATE: What is the difference between 220 V and 380 V equipment? How do I choose?
support_faq_cat_1_a2: TRANSLATE: 220 V (single-phase) suits small restaurants, cafés, and food stalls — plugs into standard mains power with easy installation. 380 V (three-phase) is designed for large commercial kitchens, central kitchens, and canteens where higher power, faster heating, and greater efficiency are needed; requires a certified electrician for installation. Our engineers conduct an on-site power survey before installation if you are unsure.
support_faq_cat_1_q3: TRANSLATE: Countertop vs. floor-standing equipment — which should I choose?
support_faq_cat_1_a3: TRANSLATE: Countertop units are compact and flexible, ideal for small kitchens with limited space; lower daily output and more budget-friendly. Floor-standing units deliver higher capacity and stability for mid-to-large commercial and central kitchens, typically with larger bowls and more powerful motors. Recommendation: kitchens under 30 m² should prioritize countertop equipment; above 30 m², choose floor-standing based on throughput needs. We provide complimentary layout planning for full-line configurations.

support_faq_cat_2_q4: TRANSLATE: How do I clean and maintain the equipment?
support_faq_cat_2_a4: TRANSLATE: Daily cleaning: Wipe surfaces with a damp cloth after each use; clean interior residue with food-grade cleaner. Daily inspection: Clear filters and drains; check blades and drive components. Weekly maintenance: Lubricate moving parts with food-grade oil; inspect power cables. Monthly deep clean: Fully disassemble and wash internal components; check consumable wear; perform function tests. Refer to the maintenance chapter of your operation manual for detailed schedules.

support_faq_cat_3_a1: TRANSLATE: YuKoLi provides a comprehensive warranty program: 1-year whole-unit warranty covering all non-man-made faults; 3-year warranty on core components (IGBT module, induction coil, pot body); consumables (blades, filters, seals) are excluded from warranty but available at preferential pricing. On-site service: major Southeast Asian cities within 24–48 hours; remote areas within 3–5 working days. Every ticket is tracked end-to-end — check progress at any time.
support_faq_cat_3_q4: TRANSLATE: What should I do if the equipment fails to start or shuts down during operation?
support_faq_cat_3_a4: TRANSLATE: Won't start: 1) Check power connection; 2) Verify main switch and equipment switch; 3) Check for error codes on display.
